FNO

PINO

results: 表2中四项任务最好，Darcy第三；Darcy相对L2误差2.55%，FNO2.35%，U-NO2.02%。浅水0.37%、Allen–Cahn0.06%、扩散吸附0.10%、扩散反应0.33%；表中±为95%置信区间。

title: Transolver Is a Linear Transformer: Revisiting Physics-Attention Through the Lens of Linear Attention
problem: Physics-Attention的性能来源及切片交互必要性不清楚。
mechanism: 把Physics-Attention表达为φ(Q)·G·ψ(K)ᵀV；解除Q/K共享投影，分别沿切片与点维softmax；去掉中间切片自注意力G。
contribution: 给出机制解释与更直接的线性注意力算子设计。
inputs_outputs: 几何/物理输入场→PDE解场
generalization_shift: 正文提到AirfRANS训练测试Reynolds数/攻角范围不同，但具体范围与OOD结果在未取得的附录D；不能据此报告数值OOD优势。

baselines: Transolver

results: 表1六任务均为所列最低相对L2；NS为0.0699，对比作者复现Transolver0.0882。表2 AirfRANS升力系数相对L2=0.0491，对比Transolver0.1230；ShapeNet-Car阻力系数0.0106对比0.0117。正文称平均参数减少40.0%、FLOPs减少36.2%；不能等同实际端到端时间加速。
limitations: 比较混合引用结果、作者复现及Transolver++按文重实现，非统一独立复现。官方正文未附训练细节/OOD附录。表3参数量单位标为GB，不能直接当参数个数引用；注意slice数增大并非单调更好。

innovation_points: 揭示Physics-Attention可写成带中间操作的线性注意力。
解除slice/deslice的共享投影并移除片间注意力，保留归一化积分核结构。
contribution_points: 以结构简化得到LinearNO，并用六类PDE和两类气动数据验证。
提供slice秩、Q/K非对称、归一化维度和slice数的消融。
给出采样网格细化时收敛到连续积分核的理论解释，假设见正文。
core_method_paragraphs: 论文把Transolver的切片投影、切片自注意力和反切片写成φ(Q)·G·ψ(K)ᵀV。原设计Q/K来自同一线性层，只是归一化轴不同；作者认为这限制了切片多样性，且片间自注意力并未稳定贡献精度。
LinearNO先给Q和K独立可学习投影，Q沿切片数归一化，K沿空间点数归一化；再把中间G设为恒等映射。先计算ψ(K)ᵀV再左乘φ(Q)，避免点数平方注意力矩阵，同时使诱导注意力的每行归一化。
正文实验支持更低相对L2和FLOPs，但不同基线来源并不完全一致。对AirfRANS工况外推，只能确认作者安排了该实验，尚未取得其附录范围/表格；因此该记录保留全文方法解读，同时明确这部分证据空缺。

title: Geometry-informed neural operator transformer for partial differential equations on arbitrary geometries
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
problem: 在不规则几何和非均匀边界采样下构建可处理变长输入的 PDE 解算子。
mechanism: 边界点云经最远点采样和球邻域分组提取局部特征，与全局位置编码通过 cross-attention/self-attention 融合；查询点解码目标场。
contribution: 以边界点云替代高分辨率体素/SDF 编码，统一多个二维、三维几何相关任务。

title: Predicting time-dependent flow over complex geometries using operator networks
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
problem: 在多种障碍物几何下学习非定常二维绕流，并检查单步准确性是否能维持到长时间滚动预测。
mechanism: 多尺度卷积分支编码历史速度；坐标与有符号距离函数组成几何 trunk；两级分支–trunk 融合预测下一时刻速度。
contribution: 将几何感知 DeepONet 扩展到非定常绕流，并同时报告逐步预测和自回归误差。
inputs_outputs: 输入历史速度 u、v 以及查询坐标和几何 SDF；输出下一时刻二维速度场。
pdes_tasks: 二维不可压 Navier–Stokes 绕流
generalization_shift: 随机划分后的未见几何实例与时间滚动；未验证整类几何留出式 OOD。
training_seen: FlowBench 的 1103 个算例中，841 个进入训练/验证池，262 个测试；三类几何随机划分。原始 242 帧每 4 帧取样至约 60 帧。
baselines: CFD 真值
不同历史窗口长度 s=1、4、8、16
results: 作者公开稿报告单步相对 L2 误差约 5%，但 60 步自回归约达 55%；短期 20–30 步更可靠。作者称最高约 1000 倍推理加速，未在本记录独立复现。
limitations: 随机几何实例划分不能解释为几何家族外泛化；尖角附近与涡旋相位会失真，长滚动积累明显。所读预印本与期刊摘要提到的 MeshGraphNet 对照可能有版本差异。

contribution_points: 提供多几何非定常绕流评测和历史长度消融。
实验证据同时显示良好单步误差与显著滚动退化，可用来研究误差传播而非只看单步分数。
core_method_paragraphs: 分支网络以多尺度卷积和池化压缩过去的速度场，trunk 网络编码查询点坐标及该点的几何 SDF。两路特征先逐元素结合，再经过第二级全局分支与局部 trunk，最后通过内积得到下一帧速度。
训练采用 FlowBench 随机划分的几何算例，推理时把预测帧送回历史窗口进行滚动。全文显示增加历史长度主要延迟误差增长，不能消除长期漂移；因此本研究的泛化证据应读作未见实例上的短期预测，而不是严格几何家族 OOD 或长期稳定求解。

pdes_tasks: 一维中子输运 Boltzmann 方程

training_seen: 标称总截面 1.0、散射截面 0.5 条件下约 1000 个归一化 GRF 源项样本。
baselines: 数值 SN 求解器
独立 equation-recast FNO/DeepONet
FNO-Pre
DON-Pre
results: 固定源表3中，DON-Pre 计算成本为纯数值求解器的约 39.5%、50.2%、64.5%；FNO-Pre 为约 56.1%、71.0%、81.3%。经典迭代容差为 1e-4；困难情形独立神经预测明显不及最终数值解。

title: Walsh-Hadamard neural operators for solving PDEs with discontinuous coefficients
problem: Fourier 基在分段常数系数、尖锐界面和不连续初值下可能出现不良谱表示。
mechanism: 用矩形波 Walsh-Hadamard 变换替换 Fourier 谱层，在截断的低 sequency 系数上学习权重；另以验证集选择 WHNO/FNO 凸组合。
contribution: 控制非谱网络和参数量以隔离谱基作用，并显示互补基集成的价值和适用边界。
inputs_outputs: 导热系数场→准稳态温度；Burgers 初速度→固定终时刻速度。

training_seen: 主导热比较在 64×64 网格、两模型各 1555153 参数、800 次批训练，每批 8 个在线生成样本，共约 6400 对；100 个独立测试样本。
baselines: 参数匹配 FNO
WHNO+FNO 集成
单层 Haar-WNO

results: 轴对齐导热 MAE：WHNO 0.01531、FNO 0.01663。七个配置中 WHNO+FNO 集成的测试 MSE 和梯度 MSE 均低于两个单模型。单层 Haar-WNO 在导热上优于 WHNO，而 Burgers 中次于 WHNO。

title: A meshfree exterior calculus for generalizable and data-efficient learning of physics from point clouds
bibtex: 未核实
problem: 稳态椭圆型 PDE 的解算子在几何、边界和物理参数变化下往往需要大量训练数据。本文尝试只学习局部通量规律，把守恒与全局求解交回离散数值结构。
mechanism: MEEC-Net 在 ε-邻域点云图上构造离散外微积分；用带多项式再现约束的边面积与虚拟体积定义离散散度，学习局部一阶通量，再通过 Newton 隐式求解并对收敛解隐式微分。
contribution: 提出无网格结构保持的局部通量学习框架；在五类稳态 PDE 上用相同训练数据比较几何/参数外推，并给出依赖稳定性和特征覆盖条件的解误差分析。
inputs_outputs: 输入点云几何、PDE 参数、源项及边界条件；输出稳态标量解或弹性位移场。局部网络输入包含解的局部候选值/梯度，整体通过隐式求解得到最终场。
pdes_tasks: 二维对流扩散、Darcy、线性弹性、非线性对流扩散、非线性 Darcy；SimJEB 复杂三维括号几何弹性。
generalization_shift: 单孔单位方形→多孔/变化孔洞几何，联合改变对流方向、扩散随机场振幅及位移边界方向；另考察点云分辨率。不是未见 PDE 家族零样本。
training_seen: 表1每任务100个训练样本；主训练域单孔，测试域改变孔洞结构与物理参数。图5单一对流扩散解辨识，图6为1–10例实验。checkpoint按训练误差选择。
baselines: PointNet、GNN、MeshGraphNets、Transolver、UPT、Linear Attention、Galerkin Attention；相同分割、输入与适用情况下的图连接及相近训练预算。
results: 已核表1（p9）：100例训练的域外归一化L2误差以百分数计，MEEC-Net在对流扩散/Darcy/弹性/非线性对流扩散/非线性Darcy分别为1.81/0.57/2.68/1.57/0.71%。同表最佳基线对应40.32/31.27/12.84/40.96/26.51%。这些数字只适用于该联合几何+参数移位协议。O(h²)解收敛仅经验观察，已证明离散散度截断精度为O(h)。

innovation_points: 以守恒的无网格离散结构承载全局物理，仅让网络学习可复用的局部本构关系。
通过边框架下的标量/向量/张量不变量输入，结合共享局部通量网络提高跨几何复用。
将多项式一致性约束、Newton 求解和隐式微分连成端到端训练流程。
contribution_points: 证据确认：表1固定100个训练样本，覆盖线性/非线性五个 PDE 的域内及几何+参数联合域外评测。
证据确认：图5–6考察单解训练与1–10例的低数据行为；不能解读为任意 PDE 的单样本泛化。
理论贡献有条件：误差分解依赖背景扩散强制性、局部 Lipschitz/稳定性与测试边特征覆盖。
core_method_paragraphs: 这篇论文并不直接把输入场一次前向传播成解，而是学习求解器缺少的局部本构通量。作者先在点云上建立有向 ε-邻域图，以关联矩阵表达离散梯度；节点虚拟体积由核密度估计确定，边虚拟面积通过满足多项式再现约束的二次优化计算。这样，网络输出的边通量可以通过共享离散散度组装为守恒方程，边界值直接施加在求解系统中。
通量网络读取邻近点的均值、方向差分以及物理参数，并用边框架的旋转不变量表达局部关系。预测阶段需要用 Newton 方法解非线性离散方程；训练阶段对收敛解做隐式微分，而不是展开每一步迭代。结构约束帮助模型把局部规律迁移到新的障碍形状、数量和物理参数，但测试时的局部特征仍须有合理训练覆盖。
实证重点是低数据和几何外推，而非一次推理比传统求解器快多少。表1的100例训练设置中，训练域为单孔单位方形，域外同时改变孔洞结构和参数范围。作者还展示复杂括号几何的弹性场预测。需要注意默认未强制所有边权非负，因此不能无条件宣称离散系统始终正定；论文的稳定性结论也有明确前提。

_abstract: We introduce a meshfree exterior calculus (MEEC) for learning structure-preserving descriptions of physics on point clouds, and use it to build MEEC-Net, a data-efficient surrogate that transfers across resolutions, geometries, and physical parameters. MEEC equips an $\epsilon$-ball graph with virtual node and edge measures via a single sparse Schur complement solve; the resulting complex satisfies discrete conservation exactly, is end-to-end differentiable in the point positions, and exposes a direct geometry-to-physics link without the mesh-generation step required by conventional structure-preserving discretizations. MEEC-Net learns unknown physics as a shared edge-wise flux law in an SO($d$)-invariant local frame, so the same kernel produces compatible fluxes on any point cloud whose features lie in the training range. We prove a solution-error bound that splits into discretization and kernel-approximation terms which is independent of problem geometry, explaining the observed transfer from very few examples. We show that single-solution training transfers to unseen geometries, boundary conditions, and physical parameters. On five canonical PDE benchmarks MEEC-Net achieves 1–2 orders of magnitude lower out-of-distribution error than baseline neural-operator approaches. On the SimJEB structural-bracket benchmark it achieves competitive error while using substantially fewer training geometries.

_abstract: The quadratic attention cost of Vision Transformers (ViTs) forces a sharp compromise between discretization and rollout horizon, and binds tightest in the fine-scale PDE regime where shocks, reaction fronts, and material interfaces occupy a small, time-varying fraction of the domain. Further, conventional neural surrogates do not adapt to localized features dynamically. We propose WAMRViT, a ViT that tokenizes its input as a balanced quadtree under a wavelet-inspired refinement criterion, encodes position and refinement level jointly via a 3D rotary positional embedding with a soft level axis, and regrids in cell space at inference to remain stable over long rollouts. A multi-scale variant additionally keeps each leaf at its native source resolution and defers the per-level resolution differential to the model. Unlike prior adaptive-tokenization work, the tokenizer imposes no a priori token count; we evaluate under fully adaptive topology over long autoregressive rollouts; and WAMRViT is the first machine-learning surrogate to natively tokenize multi-level Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) data. We demonstrate that on uniform-grid datasets, WAMRViT exceeds a finest-patch uniform backbone on the region of interest while using a fraction of the tokens, with a structural interpolation cost on the global metric that the multi-scale variant closes at the initial rollout steps. On a complex AMR combustion problem whose extremely fine scale features uniform-grid baselines cannot represent natively and must project onto a coarser grid, WAMRViT operates directly on the adaptive cells and substantially reduces finest-level error at matched parameters. _abstract: Operator learning for partial differential equations (PDEs) on arbitrary geometries builds fast neural surrogates for large-scale simulation. Although recent geometry-adaptive neural operators have made substantial progress, they are mainly designed for forward problems in which inputs and outputs share the same spatial domain. This limits their applicability for boundary value problems (BVPs) and inverse problems, where inputs and outputs may live on different domains. We introduce the Geometry-Adaptive Integral Autoencoder (GAIA), an operator learning model that encodes the domain boundary and the interior field distribution into geometry tokens, and conditions integral transform layers on these tokens via cross-attention, allowing the kernel to adapt locally to geometric features. This yields a single architecture for forward (including BVPs) and inverse problems on arbitrary domains in one pass, without retraining, iterative optimization, or graph construction. We evaluate GAIA on seven 2D and 3D benchmarks, four of which are new or substantially extended benchmarks for inverse problems and BVP: electrical impedance tomography, optical tomography, 3D Darcy flow on varying geometries, and a modified setting of Poisson BVP on mechanical components benchmark (MCB). GAIA sets new state-of-the-art results on every inverse and BVP task, reducing median relative $L^2$ error by 64\% on airfoil flow reconstruction and 27\% on EIT relative to the next best amortized method, and outperforming all baselines on every shape category of MCB. On other forward problems, GAIA is competitive with specialized solvers while maintaining stable accuracy across point resolutions on which transformer-based baselines degrade.

_abstract: Neural operators on irregular meshes face a fundamental tension. Spectral positional encodings, the natural choice for capturing geometry, require cubic-complexity eigendecomposition and inadvertently break gauge invariance through numerical solver artifacts; existing efficient approximations sacrifice gauge symmetry by design. Both failure modes break discretization invariance: models fail to transfer across mesh resolutions of the same domain, and similarly across different graphs of related structure in inductive settings. We propose GIST (Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformer), a scalable neural operator that resolves this tension by restricting attention to pairwise inner products of efficient approximate spectral embeddings. We prove these inner products estimate an exactly gauge-invariant graph kernel at end-to-end $\mathcal{O}(N)$ complexity, and establish a formal connection between gauge invariance and discretization-invariant learning with bounded mismatch error. To our knowledge, GIST is the first scalable graph neural operator with a provable discretization-mismatch bound. Empirically, GIST sets state-of-the-art on the AirfRANS, ShapeNet-Car, DrivAerNet, and DrivAerNet++ mesh benchmarks (up to 750K nodes), and additionally matches strong baselines on standard graph benchmarks (e.g., 99.50\% micro-F1 on PPI).

_abstract: Neural operator models trained on simulation data often lose accuracy when applied to experimental measurements due to the sim-to-real gap. Standard fine-tuning with limited real data can reduce this gap, but it may also damage the core physics-relevant representations learned during pretraining. Although knowledge-preserving adaptation has been widely investigated in vision or language tasks, it remains unclear whether these methods are suitable for neural operators whose architectures and protected knowledge are fundamentally different. Neural operators need to preserve core-scale physical structures rather than semantic or visual features. We propose PhysGuard, a physics-preserving framework for accurate sim-to-real adaptation of neural operators. Specifically, PhysGuard uses the empirical Fisher Information Matrix computed on simulation data to identify physics-critical parameter directions, then restricts fine-tuning updates to directions that do not interfere with them. A layer-wise Gram-matrix formulation makes this efficient for models with millions of parameters, while an adaptive threshold automatically determines the protected subspace size. A spectral probe experiment shows that the dominant Fisher directions are strongly associated with low-frequency output structures. Experiments on benchmark across four neural operator architectures and different physical systems show that PhysGuard performs strongly on most evaluation metrics compared to baselines. The benefits are most evident under severe domain shift, where it reduces low-frequency error by up to 32\% compared to standard fine-tuning while maintaining adaptability. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PhysGuard-B840/.

_abstract: Neural operators have achieved strong performance in learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs), but their inherently continuous representations struggle to capture discontinuities and sharp transitions. Existing approaches typically approximate such features within continuous function spaces, often requiring increased model capacity and high-resolution data. In this work, we propose Cut-DeepONet, a two-stage training framework that explicitly models discontinuities while reducing learning complexity. Our approach reformulates the problem via a lifting strategy, partitioning the domain into smooth subregions while representing discontinuities as boundaries in a higher-dimensional space. This separation aligns the operator learning task with the inductive bias of neural networks and avoids directly approximating discontinuities. An additional network predicts input-dependent discontinuity locations for unseen inputs, which are then used to guide the neural operator in generating smooth components within each region. Experiments on benchmark PDEs show that Cut-DeepONet outperforms state-of-the-art methods, even when trained on low-resolution datasets. The method excels on problems with discontinuities and sharp transitions, while using fewer trainable parameters. Our results highlight the benefits of changing the representation of operator learning rather than increasing model complexity.

title: TANTE: Time-adaptive operator learning via neural Taylor expansion
problem: 固定时间步算子不能随局部动力学复杂度调节计算量，并会积累滚动误差。
mechanism: 时空 patch 编码和 FiLM 时间调制，经时间/高度/宽度轴注意力预测多个时间导数及可学习可信半径；以 Taylor 多项式在半径内查询，超出则滚动重算。
contribution: 将学习的多阶时间导数与自适应时间跨度结合，并提供同骨干固定步长消融。
inputs_outputs: 输入历史物理场及相对时间戳；输出时间导数场、可信半径及由此构造的未来场。
generalization_shift: 四种任务分别训练，测试 4/8 步滚动和不同复杂度下自适应步长；没有正式验证训练采样间隔内的子步真值。
training_seen: 遵循 The Well 官方训练/验证/测试划分，每任务 100000 次迭代，训练使用 4 步预测损失；主模型约 4.5–4.8M 参数。
baselines: FNO
TFNO
AFNO
UNO
ConvNeXt U-Net
Attention U-Net
DPOT
AViT
CViT
TANTE-0 固定步长
results: 8 步辐射层相对 L2：TANTE-2 0.0988，CViT 0.1174，同骨干固定步 TANTE-0 0.1346。8 步活性物质 TANTE-1 为 0.0767，固定步为 0.0956。摘要的 60–80% 精度提升并非所有最强对照的统一幅度。
limitations: 主要规则几何、均匀网格；patch 解码有棋盘伪影；“可信半径”是学习量，并非严格数值误差界或概率置信区间。附录 B.2 明确未正式验证子时间步预测，主表 4/8 步不足以支持无限长稳定性。

innovation_points: 学习 Taylor 导数与局部有效跨度，使一次网络前向可回答一段时间内多个查询。
轴向时空注意力与同骨干固定步消融区分表示和时间自适应的贡献。
contribution_points: 在 The Well 四类非线性动力学任务比较精度、参数和推理开销。
提供半径、展开阶数、规模和时间复杂度的实验分析。
core_method_paragraphs: 每帧经卷积 patch 化，并加入空间位置编码；FiLM 将相对时间戳注入特征。多组轴向 Transformer 分别提取不同阶时间导数的潜变量，由反卷积解码器恢复导数场，另一个头输出有上下界的时间半径。
在预测半径内，用当前状态加有限阶 Taylor 多项式直接求任意查询时刻；超过范围则把预测状态送回网络。其连续查询机制与已验证精度应分开理解：作者实验采用均匀观测时间，附录承认缺乏中间时刻真值，因此尚未正式检验子步插值。

title: AOT-POT: Adaptive Operator Transformation for Large-Scale PDE Pre-training
bibtex: 未核实
publication_date: arXiv v1：2026-05-15；NeurIPS2026已录用poster，正式论文集上线日未核实。
problem: 异质PDE共同预训练时，同一残差通路被迫拟合差异很大的解算子。论文研究能否通过低参数开销、输入依赖的潜在表示变换降低这种冲突，并改善迁移、少样本微调和长期自回归误差。
mechanism: 在DPOT式patch编码、时间聚合和Fourier mixer外，以4条并行潜在流取代单一残差流；每层由当前特征生成聚合权重a、更新分配权重d及混合矩阵T，执行 X_next=T X+d^T F(a X)。T经20轮Sinkhorn行列归一化形成近似双随机矩阵；用历史帧加噪预测下一帧的目标训练。
contribution: 将输入自适应的多流连接作为多PDE预训练的改进方向，并用同源/跨PDE线性变换对照、模块消融、微调和长滚动实验支持其效用。最扎实结论是相近参数预算下改进DPOT；“变换把原算子化简”的数学解释目前主要是机制类比和经验证据。
inputs_outputs: 主设置输入10帧二维多通道场及坐标编码，输出下一帧，随后自回归。预处理统一到128×128并补齐物理通道，非规则区域另带mask。默认不输入PDE类别或显式系数；附录波动方程另比较加入波速c(x)的参数知情输入。
pdes_tasks: 12个预训练数据集：FNO二维不可压NS的3个黏度；PDEBench压缩NS的4个参数设置、扩散反应、浅水；PDEArena NS/条件NS；CFDBench。下游包括高分辨率/不同Re的二维湍流、三维NS、CNO稳态任务、Kolmogorov流以及Wave-Layer/Wave-Gauss；还测20–500步滚动和16–2000样本微调。12个数据集不等于12个互不相同的PDE家族。
generalization_shift: 必须分三层理解：表1所谓zero-shot是预训练已覆盖的12个数据集的保留测试样本，不是未见方程零样本。真正下游分布变化包括分辨率/Re、2D→3D、时间演化→稳态和新波动方程，但表2的FT模型都微调500 epoch；不带FT的是目标任务从头训练，也不是零样本。Wave-Layer少样本结果同样微调500 epoch。NS(1e-4)、CNS等下游与预训练家族重叠，不能全部统称unseen PDE。
training_seen: 主模型Tiny/Small/Medium约7M/31M/124M参数，在上述12集混合预训练1000 epoch，batch160、8×H200。表7各集训练样本为900–9800，测试60–1000；预训练子集微调200 epoch，下游全参数微调500 epoch。附录表8列出若干下游2000/200训练/测试分配；表2四任务与表8列名并不完全逐项对应，具体每个下游的完整文件级划分未核实。
baselines: FNO/Geo-FNO、UNet、FFNO、GK-Transformer、GNOT、OFormer；多数据预训练FNO-m、MPP、DPOT、MoE-POT；附录另与Poseidon-T/B比较。需区分独立单数据训练、多数据预训练、从头下游训练、下游FT四类协议，以及参数数目和输入信息不同。
results: 表1逐列重算：31M AOT-POT-S相对30M DPOT-S的12集平均相对L2误差降幅40.90%，最大77.63%来自FNO ν=1e-3的0.0131→0.00293。表2小模型FT：湍流0.041 vs DPOT-FT 0.129、3D 0.057 vs0.254、Kolmogorov0.026 vs0.089；稳态0.005 vs0.019采用相对中位L1，不能与其他列L2混合。表3生成的长NS轨迹上，500步AOT-FT-S为0.00401，DPOT-FT-S为0.02911。表4 Wave-Layer用16样本FT为0.21，优于DPOT用64样本的0.26。表31单H200/batch1推理8.010ms vs DPOT-S 7.795ms，增加约2.8%，不是加速。
limitations: 作者明确缺少严谨算子逼近理论和T结构到PDE方程的正式对应。双随机混合矩阵的谱范数有界，只约束该混合部分；不自动保证整个输入依赖网络或物理滚动稳定，也不意味着可逆或保体积。核心预训练仍以标准化二维网格为主，OOD优势主要来自有监督微调。Poseidon参数知情比较没有全面胜出：表21 Wave-Gauss为AOT-S 0.0807、Poseidon-T 0.0775；同节讨论又写AOT-S 0.0717，存在表文冲突，本条采用表值。摘要最大92%/89%未用作无条件总体结论。

innovation_points: 把固定单流残差连接改为输入依赖的聚合、分配、跨流混合三件套，在共享Fourier子层前后调整潜在表示。
采用Sinkhorn双随机约束控制残差混合的放大效应，而非堆叠大量专家网络。
用同PDE与跨PDE冻结线性变换的对照说明“适合一个方程的表示不一定适合另一个”，但这仍是设计动机的实验验证。
contribution_points: 提供相近容量DPOT/MoE-POT比较，表1支持多PDE联合预训练的参数效率。
区分从头训练与预训练微调，展示分辨率、维度、稳态/动态和波动方程适配，以及少样本和长滚动改进。
提供消融和实际推理时延，显示收益并非仅以明显增大模型和推理成本换来。
core_method_paragraphs: 先把不同来源PDE的场统一为网格张量，用patch投影和带时间信息的聚合压成隐表示。Fourier mixer承担空间全局交互，与DPOT主干保持接近；AOT的变化集中在主干子层之间的信息连接方式。因此，它学习的不是显式符号PDE变换，也不需要先识别方程名称。
通常残差层是X+F(X)。AOT把X扩成n条流，用a对流做凸组合后送进同一个F，再用d把F的输出分送回各流；与此同时，T混合原来各条流。a、d、T都由当前隐表示的空间全局平均、RMSNorm和小型投影得到，能够随输入动力学改变。默认n=4；最后以可学习softmax门控把各流合并成下一帧预测。这种结构可理解为在不同潜在通路上选择、更新和交换信息，而不应直接等同于严格可逆的基变换。
T被限制为非负且行列和约为1的双随机矩阵，避免无约束残差乘积轻易放大信号；a归一化到概率单纯形，d用2×sigmoid参数化。训练仍采用历史场加高斯噪声、回归干净下一帧的去噪目标。贡献的归因应看三项映射消融和同预算DPOT比较；下游新方程的成功则包含500 epoch端到端适配，不能归因为零样本自动识别所有物理规律。

_abstract: Pre-training neural operators on diverse PDE datasets has emerged as a promising paradigm for building general-purpose surrogate models in scientific machine learning. However, the inherent complexity and structural diversity of PDE solution operators make multi-PDE pre-training fundamentally difficult. Existing approaches address this mainly by enlarging model capacity, while the target solution operators themselves remain unchanged. Inspired by classical numerical analysis---where a problem-tailored operator transformation reformulates a complex PDE into a numerically easier equivalent---we propose to similarly reformulate the target solution operators, turning a heterogeneous set of complex, structurally divergent operators into a simpler and better-aligned equivalents. Since different PDEs admit different simplifications, the transformation must be adaptive and input-dependent, so that a single neural operator can approximate the entire family jointly. We instantiate this idea as AOT-POT (Adaptive Operator-Transformation for Pre-training Operator Transformer), which realizes such a transformation by expanding the hidden representation into multiple parallel streams, aggregating and redistributing them with input-dependent weights before and after each sub-layer, and mixing streams through Sinkhorn-projected doubly stochastic matrices for stable training. Together, these mechanisms reformulate the diverse, complex solution operators into a simpler equivalents that a single architecture can approximate jointly. Empirically, AOT-POT achieves state-of-the-art results on 12 PDE benchmarks with only 3% additional parameters, reducing the relative L2 error by up to 77.6% (40.9% on average). Fine-tuning further reduces L2 error by up to 92% on in-domain PDEs and 89% on out-of-domain PDEs, confirming that adaptive operator transformation is an orthogonal and effective axis for advancing PDE foundation models, beyond merely scaling model capacity.

_abstract: An important application of neural networks to scientific computing has been the learning of non-linear operators. In this framework, a neural network is trained to fit a non-linear map between two infinite dimensional spaces, for example, the solution operator of ordinary and partial differential equations. Recently, inspired by the discovery of in-context learning for large language models, an even more ambitious paradigm has been explored, called multi-operator learning. In this approach, a neural network is trained to learn many different operators at the same time. In order to evaluate one of the learned operators, the network is passed example inputs and outputs to disambiguate the desired operator. In this work, we provide a precise mathematical formulation of the multi-operator learning problem. In addition, we modify a simple efficient architecture, called DeepOSets, for multi-operator learning and prove its universality for multi-operator learning. Finally, we provide experiments showing the efficacy of DeepOSets for learning multiple operators corresponding to different initial-value and boundary-value differential equation problems.

title: Latent Generative Solvers for Generalizable Long-Term Physics Simulation

problem: 统一多类物理系统的神经求解器在自回归时会把自身误差不断喂回，短期准确并不保证长期可靠。论文同时研究共享低维物理表示、长滚动误差纠正和生成式动力学的计算开销。
mechanism: 两阶段LGS：先训练并冻结PhyVAE，将128×128×3物理场压为16×16×16潜变量；再训练Pyramidal Flow-Forcing Transformer。训练时把当前潜状态按(1-k)x+kz加噪，与下一干净状态构成flow-matching桥，预测下一状态端点；context由模型预测状态递推更新，历史做时间金字塔压缩。v2推理从当前潜状态直接积分概率流ODE，不重新显式加噪。
contribution: 将共享VAE、输入噪声训练、基于自身预测的context更新和时间金字塔结合，用于多系统长期预测；统一四个公开PDE集合的评价协议，并给出长期误差、模块消融、同总参数扩容基线及有限OOD适配证据。稳定性理论是有假设的充分条件分析。
inputs_outputs: 输入4帧完整物理场历史，先编码；潜空间动力学递推预测下一潜状态，按需解码成物理场。维持随轨迹变化的context c作为动力学描述，不需显式方程输入。输出是点预测/滚动场，当前评价主要为L2误差，不等同于已验证校准的概率不确定性。
pdes_tasks: 训练统一16系统/12家族：FNO NS三黏度、PDEArena NS/条件NS/浅水、PDEBench压缩NS低/高参数与浅水、The Well的active matter、Gray–Scott、行星浅水、Rayleigh–Bénard、shear flow、turbulent radiative layer、viscoelastic instability。测1/5/10/20步预测；额外256² Kolmogorov流OOD适配，以及观测噪声/空间遮挡。
generalization_shift: 主表1/附录H11的16系统均来自预训练语料，是已见系统的保留样本与滚动时域扩展，不是16个新PDE的零样本迁移。Kolmogorov流明确排除在预训练之外，同时改变流动/外力设置和128²→256²分辨率；NS方程家族本身训练已见，故不宜称完全未知的PDE定律。报告零样本误差与用10%目标数据、5 epoch仅微调潜动力学后的误差。只能据此确认该目标上的有限OOD适配，不能推为任意几何/构成关系零样本泛化。
training_seen: 作者称统一约250万轨迹、233GB；16系统等概率采样，float16、统一3通道及128²，8:1:1训练/验证/测试。PhyVAE249M参数训练100k步并冻结，PFlowFT138M再训100k步，缓存潜轨迹；默认训练噪声k=1。确定性基线约150M活动参数，训练200k步、同4帧历史；另训练约400M基线以对齐LGS387M总参数。通道统一会丢弃部分变量，如PDEBench CNS的y速度。
baselines: 重训U-AFNO152M、CNextUNet153M、DPOT160M；补充U-AFNO404M与DPOT396M；将DiffusionPDE与FunDiff改造到4帧自回归协议。PDE-Refiner等专门稳定器/多尺度概率算子未纳入完整协议匹配比较，作者将其列为后续比较方向。
results: 主表1：LGS单步6.0%，U-AFNO5.5%，并非单步最优；5/10步LGS12.1%/18.3%，各在15/16系统最低。附录H11的20步仅覆盖11系统，LGS均值30.2%，U-AFNO56.1%；其中W-AM是65.3% vs57.8%，故不是每个系统都胜。表2 held-out Kolmogorov零样本0.3984 vs U-AFNO0.6528，5 epoch/10%目标数据后0.1291 vs0.3430。表H3去掉生成式流匹配，10步18.3%→46.5%；去噪或context分别变23.5%/24.5%。表H1预测器1.3 GFLOPs，约为确定性基线的1/13至1/77；这不包含场编码/解码，也不是端到端墙钟加速倍数。
limitations: 仅实证二维；冻结VAE存在约3%重构误差下限，并可能丢失罕见/被过滤物理通道。稳定性要求滚动偏差落在训练噪声覆盖方向、缩放残差满足Lipschitz条件等，尚未实证认证；稳定滚动不保证守恒或物理解支正确。编解码分别约70/113 GFLOPs每帧，如逐帧需要物理场，解码成本不能省略，13–77倍不能当完整求解加速。主表1的10步DPOT/U-AFNO为33.8%/29.1%，而附录H11逐系统数值均值重算约29.59%/29.63%，有内部不一致。20步只11系统且非全胜。未找到本论文代码/标准化语料的可验证发布入口。

contribution_points: 建立来自四个公开集合的统一16系统多时距协议，并同时报告活动参数和总参数匹配比较。

core_method_paragraphs: 第一阶段PhyVAE把统一后的物理场压到紧凑潜空间，通过重构损失与KL正则训练，随后冻结、缓存所有轨迹。第二阶段不再直接在高分辨率网格回归，而以当前潜状态和从历史推断的context c为条件预测下一潜状态。VAE+Transformer本身沿用已有生成建模骨架，本文主要设计针对的是多步滚动中的状态误差和条件误差。
训练时设起点为(1-k)x_s+kz，在线性桥上采样流时间t，网络预测干净下一状态端点，并用除以(1-t)的加权误差形成流匹配损失。预测出的状态还经门控交叉注意力更新下一步context，梯度穿过该更新，避免训练一直依赖完美真实历史。近期保留4帧完整潜状态，更早信息按指数间隔汇入时间金字塔；因此长期信息不必全部以全分辨率token保留。
v2明确区分训练噪声和推理：推理不再次加噪，而从现有自回归潜状态积分概率流ODE。默认k=1意味着训练桥起点本身不携带当前状态，预测信号主要由轨迹context提供，不能将k误说为推理时可自由调节的旋钮。作者用去噪训练下的有效收缩解释长滚动收益，但其收缩常数和噪声方向覆盖是理论假设/条件，实验改善不能升级为无条件稳定保证。

_abstract: Reliable physics simulation requires both broad generalization across heterogeneous PDE families and stability under long autoregressive rollouts. Current neural solvers rarely provide both. Deterministic operators accumulate rollout error, while probabilistic solvers typically remain tied to a single PDE family or a short prediction horizon. We address this gap with the \textbf{Latent Generative Solver} (LGS), which couples a Physics VAE (PhyVAE) with a Pyramidal Flow-Forcing Transformer (PFlowFT). PhyVAE compresses states from twelve PDE families into a shared \emph{physical manifold}, separating dynamics-relevant structure from the ambient state space. PFlowFT then predicts the next latent state through input-noised flow matching, yielding a sufficient-condition contraction mechanism that explains improved autoregressive rollout stability. Pretrained on a 2.5\,M-trajectory, 16-system corpus at $128^2$ resolution, LGS obtains the lowest relative $L_2$ error (L2RE) on 15 of 16 systems at both 5- and 10-step rollout. At 20 steps, LGS reduces the L2RE from $56.1\%$ to $\mathbf{30.2\%}$ against matched deterministic and adapted generative baselines, while requiring $\mathbf{13}$--$\mathbf{77\times}$ less recurrent dynamics-step compute. On a held-out $256^2$ Kolmogorov flow, LGS reduces the 1-step L2RE from $0.398$ to $0.129$ within five finetuning epochs; U-AFNO achieves only $0.653$ to $0.343$ under the same protocol.

_abstract: Most physical systems are governed by nonlinear partial differential equations, yet the analytical tools that make linear systems transparent, such as eigenspectra, dispersion relations and modal decomposition, remain unavailable in nonlinear settings. We introduce Lie Generator Network-Koopman (LGN-KM), a neural operator that lifts nonlinear dynamics into a linear latent space and learns the continuous-time Koopman generator through the decomposition $L_k = S - D_k$, where $S$ is skew-symmetric (conservative coupling) and $D_k$ is positive-definite diagonal (mode-selective dissipation). The decomposition guarantees stability by construction and exposes the eigenstructure directly, making linear-systems analysis available on a nonlinear PDE. On 2D Navier-Stokes turbulence, the generator recovers a complete multi-branch dispersion relation and the viscous dissipation scaling $\mathrm{Re}(\lambda) \propto -|k|^2$ from trajectory data alone, with no physics supervision. The same architecture recovers the analogous diffusive scaling on FitzHugh-Nagumo reaction-diffusion without modification. Independently trained models at different regimes show matched gauge-invariant spectral structure. The architecture additionally enables long-horizon stability, $O(1)$ continuous-time evaluation, and physics--informed cross-regime model transfer.

title: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
bibtex: 未核实
publication_date: arXiv v1：2026-10-09；NeurIPS2026已录用poster，正式论文集上线日未核实。
problem: 希望用一个预训练模型，直接从可变数量的时空坐标–观测值推断查询位置的PDE解，不在每个测试实例上重新优化；同时研究近似PINN解作为不完美训练先验是否仍有用。
mechanism: 对PDE实例分布做PFN式episode训练：抽取一个解场，再抽context坐标–值与query坐标，遮住query值并回归。Transformer在context内自注意力、query对context交叉注意力；用AGF注意力谱成分过滤与正交正则、rational激活。MSE的总体最优目标是条件后验预测均值，模型是确定性回归器，不输出完整后验分布。
contribution: 把PFN式先验拟合用于无方程输入的点集条件PDE预测，证明并实验讨论MSE的后验均值含义；同一CDR检查点支持任务/系数变化下的零梯度ICL；跨PDE转移则通过微调完成。
inputs_outputs: 输入context D={(x,t,u)}及待求的query坐标(x,t)，输出这些query的解值。可以用不规则、可变长度观测，不要求显式方程或另行给出算子级输入–输出演示；但必须有足以识别目标动力学的观测。CNSE从初始4通道场直接预测4个未来时刻；Darcy为系数场a(x)→稳态u(x)。
pdes_tasks: 主预训练二维对流–扩散–反应CDR家族；评价时空插值、同家族系数插值/外推、观测之后的时间预测；微调目标为浅水SWE、压缩Navier–Stokes CNSE。附录含Airfoil不规则网格、Darcy椭圆问题、三维扩散反应和三维Gray–Scott。
generalization_shift: 零梯度结论限于CDR同族任务与系数变化：训练系数各取{0,0.5,1}；测试插值{0.25,0.75}，外推{1.25,1.5}。主表3“时间外推”是从t=0.1观测预测0.2–0.5，仍在预训练时间范围内；真正系数+训练时间范围双外推在附录H.4。SWE/CNSE等跨族先微调，再在测试实例上无梯度预测；SWE unseen指没参加微调的300个初值样本，不是没见过SWE。H.5/H.6更换/随机初值会重新训练，不能解释为原检查点零样本初值分布外泛化。附加3D实验有训练，2D→3D的完整初始化路径未核实。
training_seen: CDR为7个系数、每个3取值，共2187个参数组合；主实验共享初值1+sin(2x)sin(2y)，网格32×32，预训练时间0–0.5的6帧。分别以数值解和2187个独立PINN的近似解训练两个版本，PINN先验平均L2RE约0.02280。SWE以700/1000初值轨迹微调；CNSE为700/100/200训练/验证/测试。SWE称使用任务专用基线一半epoch，但精确总优化步数未核实。变通道迁移会重置编码器首层和解码器末层。
baselines: DeepONet、FNO、F-FNO、A-FNO、LNO；Poseidon和DPOT采用公开预训练权重再微调。时空插值主表只比DeepONet；附录增加匹配数据/观测/预算的GNOT，Airfoil另比OFormer。多数网格基线滚动预测，PDE-PFN直接查询未来时刻；CNSE中DeepONet和DPOT也按文中调整为直接多时刻预测，不能与各基线原论文数值混比。
results: 表2已见CDR系数时间外推：数值先验/PINN先验L2RE为0.02261/0.02705，F-FNO为0.03430。表3系数插值、从0.1预测0.2–0.5时，两版本0.11990/0.12465；系数外推对应0.01068/0.02169，评价时间范围需一同标注。表4微调后的SWE未见初值，时间外推0.03323/0.03288，F-FNO为0.04218。表5 CNSE L2RE为0.54833/0.54369，F-FNO为0.55420；但L1绝对误差F-FNO更好，不能称全面胜出。表25与GNOT的CDR系数插值时空插值L2几乎相同，GNOT0.01657略优于0.01658。表29模型约4.49M参数，但CDR测试0.24秒/样本并不是最快。
limitations: 主CDR先验仅离散系数、固定初值，不能代表任意PDE或任意观测分布。无符号输入的确定性模型无法区分完全相同context下的不同动力学：附录H.14在仅相同初值时两方程预测相同，加入少量后续观测才改善。无偏且跨点独立噪声定理不保证消除PINN系统偏差或相关误差，更不保证恢复精确解/校准不确定性。没有严格PDE残差、守恒或边界条件约束；H.16仅提供近似周期一致性。架构与训练配方同时改变，GNOT对照不能单独证明PFN训练的因果收益。

补充context不可辨识性、观测时间、偏置噪声、周期边界一致性和匹配GNOT对照，使适用边界更明确。
core_method_paragraphs: PFN的学习对象不是某一固定方程的一次解，而是“看到一组观测后，怎样预测同一实例的其他位置”。每次训练从先验中的一个PDE解场抽取context与query，query只给坐标，数值被遮住。context域坐标与观测值分别编码，query坐标单独编码；模型通过context自注意力汇集可辨别动力学的信息，再让query交叉读取context并输出解值。主实验混合相邻时间点的context/query抽样，使一个检查点同时适应插值与未来查询。
编码器/解码器是MLP，注意力部分采用AGF对谱成分自适应加权，并附加正交正则；rational激活提高非线性表达的灵活性。论文还支持Fourier特征，但J.4明确主CDR、SWE、CNSE选择FFE=0，因而不能将它当成这些主结果的必要机制。损失是query值的MSE加AGF正则，在总体极限下目标为给定context的后验预测均值，而非可采样的完整PDE后验。
近似PINN解用来生成训练先验，测试主要由真实观测条件化，从而允许模型在统计意义上改善不完美先验。理论要求目标噪声无偏、独立等条件；对实际PINN的有偏、相关误差只是经验检验。跨CDR系数的适应通过context完成，不更新权重；转到SWE/CNSE等新家族则先对模型微调，必要时重置输入/输出边界层，然后才对单个新实例进行无梯度ICL。

_abstract: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we seek to bring similar capabilities to PDE solvers. In addition, inspired by the posterior predictive mean-based inference mechanism of the in-context learning in prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), we propose PDE-PFN, a prior-data fitted neural solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning. PDE-PFN builds on a PFN architecture with self- and cross-attention mechanisms of Transformer and is pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions generated by physics-informed neural networks, serving as diverse but not necessarily exact priors. Through experiments on a range of two-dimensional PDEs, we demonstrate that PDE-PFN achieves empirical generalization across heterogeneous equations, robustness under noisy priors, and zero-gradient-update in-context inference capability. Our approach not only outperforms task-specific baselines but also provides a flexible and robust framework for advancing SciML.

_abstract: Long-horizon forecasting of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) is critical for characterizing the sustained evolution of physical systems. While neural operators have emerged as efficient surrogates, they typically learn implicit finite-time transitions from discrete observations. When deployed autoregressively, such propagators often suffer from rapid error accumulation and dynamic drift. To address this, we propose a neural forecasting framework that reformulates PDE rollout as learning a Structured Spectral Propagator (SSP) in a propagation-oriented latent space. Following an analysis-propagation-synthesis design, our framework: (i) maps physical states into a shared, time-consistent spatial representation; (ii) projects this space into a compact propagation state to isolate recurrent dynamics from fine-grained spatial details, thereby decoupling reconstruction fidelity from rollout regularity; and (iii) evolves retained spectral modes using a frequency-conditioned linear backbone complemented by a nonlinear spectral closure to account for truncated interactions. This explicit structuring endows the propagator with a strong inductive bias for coherent modal evolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SSP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing relative $L_2$ errors by up to 48.9\% and exhibiting improved stability in temporal extrapolation beyond the supervised horizon.

_abstract: We introduce Tadpole, a novel foundation model for three-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) that addresses key challenges in transferability, scalability to high dimensionality, and multi-functionality. Tadpole is pre-trained as an autoencoder on synthetic 3D PDE data generated by an efficient online data-generation framework. This enables large-scale, diverse training without storage or I/O overhead, demonstrated by scaling to an equivalent of hundreds of terabytes of training data. By autoencoding single-channel spatial crops, Tadpole learns rich and transferable representations across heterogeneous physical systems with varying numbers of state variables and spatial resolutions. Although pre-trained solely as an autoencoder, Tadpole can be efficiently applied for multiple downstream tasks beyond reconstruction, including dynamics learning and generative modeling. For dynamics learning, we propose a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy that integrates low-rank adaptation, latent-space transformations, and reintroduced skip connections, achieving accurate temporal modeling with a minimal number of trainable parameters. Tadpole demonstrates strong fine-tuning performance across various downstream tasks, highlighting its versatility and effectiveness as a foundation model for 3D PDE learning.

contribution: 在不修改已训练扩散模型的情况下加入滚动规划，减少长期误差积累。
inputs_outputs: 输入近期场序列，输出可变长度未来场片段及采样不确定度。
generalization_shift: 重点为超过短片段训练窗口的长时滚动，不是任意未见方程零样本求解。
training_seen: 按任务训练条件扩散模型；与固定步长PDERefiner使用同样架构和权重来隔离规划效应。
baselines: FNO、FactFormer、Transolver、PDERefiner、WDNO；多数约3M参数，WDNO约21M是明示例外。

title: BiLO: Bilevel Local Operator Learning for PDE Inverse Problems
problem: 从有限带噪观测反演 PDE 参数/函数，同时避免直接加权数据拟合和物理残差的矛盾。
mechanism: 下层在当前参数附近训练局部解算子，损失含 PDE 残差及对参数的残差梯度；上层只优化观测数据误差，以同时梯度下降更新两层。
contribution: 不需预训练整个参数域的全局算子，通过局部算子提供反演下降方向。
inputs_outputs: 输入观测位置/场值、PDE 与初始参数猜测；输出反演参数或函数及一致的解场。
generalization_shift: 与在有限参数域训练的全局 DeepONet 比较 OOD 真参数；BiLO 本身是逐实例优化，不是冻结模型的零样本预测。
training_seen: 先在初始参数 θ0 预训练局部算子；可选使用 θ0 的一个数值解加速。每种实验运行 5 个随机种子，噪声/初始化变化。
baselines: PINN 不同数据损失权重
DeepONet 全局算子：粗/密/OOD 训练域
Bilevel PINN（附录）
results: Fisher–KPP 图4–5显示 BiLO 对噪声和参数域外情形更稳，作者报告低/零噪声某些参数误差降低可达一个数量级。全局 DeepONet 的 OOD 训练域把反应参数上限限制为 1.8，而真实参数在域外，性能明显退化。
limitations: 仍需每个反演实例的预训练与微调；下层残差梯度有权重和优化成本。精确上层梯度的一致性依赖理想下层收敛等条件，实际为近似梯度；主比较未纳入众多先进 PINN 优化改进。

innovation_points: 用局部解算子及参数敏感度约束构造双层反演，避开学习完整参数域。
直接计算当前网络的参数偏导近似上层下降方向，而不显式求伴随或完整超梯度。
contribution_points: 评测标量参数、空间未知函数、噪声/稀疏观测以及真实二维肿瘤数据。
给出理想条件下一致性与下层误差影响分析，并区分实际近似优化。
core_method_paragraphs: 把坐标和待反演参数一同输入网络。在当前参数处，下层同时压低 PDE 残差及其对参数的梯度，从而学习不仅满足当前方程、还近似附近参数变化的局部解算子。预训练固定初始参数，随后参数与网络权重分别沿数据损失和局部算子损失更新。
该方法避免 PINN 在同一目标中直接平衡观测拟合和方程残差，但并非完全没有超参数：下层仍含残差梯度权重，实际训练也不精确解下层问题。其优势属于逐实例物理反演与适配，不能混同可直接跨实例调用的全局算子。

title: EquiNO: A physics-informed neural operator for multiscale simulations
problem: 为 FE² 多尺度非线性弹性模拟提供满足微观平衡与周期边界条件的快速代理。
mechanism: 用位移/应力快照构建 POD 基；应力基满足离散平衡，位移基满足周期性；双网络预测系数，以两条路线的本构应力一致性单损失训练。
contribution: 将平衡和边界约束编入低维表示，并嵌入宏观有限元替代昂贵微观求解。
inputs_outputs: 输入宏观应变；输出固定微结构的微观位移/应力场与等效应力。
generalization_shift: 宏观载荷/应变采样变化与宏观结构应用；未证明对未见微结构通用。
training_seen: 每个 RVE 用约 100 个有解快照构建基，约 2000 个无标签应变点训练，100 个测试点。不能称完全无数据。
baselines: VIONet+
DeepONet
FNO
OFormer
FE²
results: RVE1 表2应力平均误差 EquiNO 约 3.56%，VIONet+ 约 5.97%，DeepONet 约 7.65%。作者报告各 RVE 平均应力误差小于 5%，某宏观案例最高约 8000 倍加速；未独立复现。
limitations: POD 基依赖已有微结构快照；主要适用周期边界、准静态非线性弹性，不能据此扩展到任意新微结构或时变塑性。物理约束精确程度仍受基/离散化影响。

core_method_paragraphs: 先从已求解的微观快照提取位移和应力 POD 模态。位移模态继承周期性，平衡应力模态继承离散平衡；两个分支网络从宏观应变预测各自的展开系数。
位移路线导出微观应变并经过材料本构，得到一套应力；应力路线直接重构另一套应力。训练最小化两者差异。这样可把部分约束放入表示空间，但仍使用快照生成基，且本构一致性是优化目标，不应将所有方程说成无误差满足。

_abstract: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder--decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based--encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer--based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $23.19$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce Meridian, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, feasibility prediction, active trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within the evaluation budget, the ViT-FMDiT and Meridian combination yields the best target-driven objective score, outperforming DANTE, TuRBO, and BAxUS by $\sim6$\% in relative error on the same decoder.

_abstract: Derivative-informed training improves neural operators by directly supervising their input--output sensitivities, but existing methods rely on offline tangent solves and stored derivative labels. We propose sketched tangent consistency loss (sTCL), an on-the-fly drop-in derivative regularizer for neural-operator training that improves learned Jacobians without changing the architecture or generating offline sensitivity data. At each training step, sTCL samples a small number of perturbation directions in the input function space, computes the corresponding surrogate Jacobian--vector products using forward-mode automatic differentiation, and penalizes the residual of the forward sensitivity equation. This equation is obtained by differentiating the governing PDE with respect to the input perturbation direction, so derivative supervision is obtained directly from the physics rather than from stored tangent labels. We further show that sketching makes online derivative-informed training computationally feasible, while conditioning is the key to making it effective. Random directional sketching keeps the derivative penalty at the same order of cost as the standard data-fitting loss, making sTCL compatible with stochastic neural-network training as a lightweight loss term. However, raw forward-sensitivity residual penalties can fail for stiff, ill-conditioned, or indefinite tangent operators. To address this, we introduce lightweight operator-aware preconditioners selected by a simple tangent-operator decision rule. Across four PDE benchmarks---Helmholtz, nonlinear diffusion--reaction, Burgers, and two-dimensional Navier--Stokes---operator-conditioned sTCL achieves accuracy comparable to offline DIFNO while eliminating the offline derivative-data generation stage. These results show that on-the-fly derivative-informed training need not merely amortize offline tangent-solve cost into training; with appropriate sketching and conditioning, sTCL provides an attractive drop-in path to derivative-informed neural operators.

_abstract: We introduce FLASH-MAX, a shallow, exact-by-construction neural network architecture for predicting homogeneous electromagnetic fields from sparse pointwise observations. Each hidden neuron represents a separate exact solution to Maxwell's equations, so that the network satisfies the governing equations symbolically by construction and can be trained end-to-end from sparse data within seconds. We prove a universal approximation result showing that this exact model class remains universal on arbitrary domains. FLASH-MAX reaches sub-1% relative validation error from about 1K sparse pointwise observations in seconds, all while maintaining a zero PDE residual, and keeps single digit errors even for only 100 observations sampled from 3D space. These results suggest that moving governing structure from the loss into the hypothesis class can dramatically improve the trade-off between precision and optimization speed in scientific machine learning.

_abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) surrogate modeling often relies on either dense observations or access to governing equations/physics constraints. In practice, observations can be sparse and partial, and the underlying physics may be partially specified or unavailable. We introduce SBNO, an equation-free paired‑data diffusion bridge matching framework that learns conditional operators for both forward and inverse PDE problems under partial observations. SBNO learns a pair of time-dependent forward/backward drifts via diffusion Schrödinger bridge matching, using a unified endpoint coupling that preserves empirical input-solution pairing, enabling both directions to be handled within a single framework. At inference time, SBNO performs deterministic reconstruction by integrating the probability-flow ODE of the learned bridge, eliminating the need for inference-time hyperparameter tuning. On five PDE benchmarks with 5\% observations, SBNO achieves superior or comparable accuracy to baselines while demonstrating lower test-instance error dispersion. Furthermore, SBNO is at least $9.7\times$ faster and reduces GPU memory by at least $4.3\times$ compared to diffusion-based baselines.

_abstract: Data assimilation (DA) for systems governed by partial differential equations (PDE) aims to reconstruct full spatiotemporal fields from sparse high-fidelity (HF) observations while respecting physical constraints. While full-grid low-fidelity (LF) simulations provide informative priors in multi-fidelity settings, recovering an HF field consistent with both sparse observations and the governing PDE typically requires per-instance test-time optimization, which becomes a major bottleneck in time-critical applications. To alleviate this, amortized reconstruction using generative models has recently been proposed; however, such approaches rely on full-field HF supervision during training, which is often impractical in real-world settings. From a more realistic perspective, we propose the Physics-Informed Conditional Schrödinger Bridge (PICSB), which transports an informative LF prior toward an auxiliary-energy-defined, observation-conditioned HF endpoint law without any additional inference-time guidance. To enable learning without HF endpoints, PICSB employs an iterative surrogate-endpoint refresh scheme, and directly incorporates PDE residuals into the training objective while enforcing observations via hard conditioning throughout sampling. Experiments on fluid PDE benchmarks demonstrate that PICSB enables extremely fast spatiotemporal field reconstruction while achieving strong accuracy under sparse HF supervision.

_abstract: The modeling and simulation of infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian systems are central problems in mathematical physics and engineering, but they pose significant computational and structural challenges for standard data-driven architectures. In this work, we introduce the Symplectic Neural Operator, a neural operator architecture designed to preserve the symplectic structure intrinsic to Hamiltonian PDEs. We provide a theoretical characterization of their symplecticity and establish a rigorous long-term stability result based on the combination of symplectic structure preservation and learning accuracy. Numerical experiments on canonical Hamiltonian PDEs corroborate this theoretical result and show that SNOs exhibit improved energy behavior compared with non-structure-preserving neural operators.

_abstract: Diffusion-based models have demonstrated impressive accuracy and generalization in solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, they still face significant limitations, such as high sampling costs and insufficient physical consistency, stemming from their many-step iterative sampling mechanism and lack of explicit physics constraints. To address these issues, we propose \emph{Phys-Instruct}, a novel physics-guided distillation framework which (1) not only compresses a pre-trained diffusion PDE solver into a few-step generator via matching generator and prior diffusion distributions to enable rapid sampling, (2) but also enhances the physics consistency by explicitly injecting PDE knowledge through a PDE distillation guidance. Phys-Instruct is built upon a solid theoretical foundation, leading to a practical physics-constrained training objective that admits tractable gradients. Across five PDE benchmarks, Phys-Instruct achieves orders-of-magnitude faster inference while reducing PDE Error by more than 8$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art diffusion baselines. Moreover, the resulting unconditional student model functions as a compact prior, enabling efficient and physically consistent inference for various downstream conditional tasks.  Our results indicate that Phys-Instruct is a novel, effective, and efficient framework for ultra-fast PDE solving powered by deep generative models.

_abstract: Accurate emulation of multi-scale physical systems governed by PDEs demands models that remain stable over long autoregressive rollouts while preserving fine-scale structures. Deterministic emulators produce overly-smoothed predictions, while generative approaches better capture details but are costly. Latent-space generative models have emerged as a compromise but with the additional cost of separately pre-trained autoencoders. We propose Wavelet Flow Matching (WFM), a novel generative emulator that overcomes current trade-offs between cost and skill by performing optimal-transport directly in the multi-scale wavelet space. Rather than learning a latent compression, WFM leverages the hierarchical structure of a U-Net to jointly predict transport velocities of a prescribed wavelet representation. On three challenging systems of chaotic fluid dynamics, WFM achieves superior long-horizon stability, accuracy and spectral coherence compared to state-of-the-art models. Our results clearly position the wavelet space as an effective training-free representation for generative emulation of complex physical dynamics.

title: Adaptive Fourier Decomposition-guided Neural Operator Design for Inverse PDE Problems
problem: 逆PDE参数可能稀疏或不光滑，单纯Hilbert空间建模和黑盒网络设计不易解释。
mechanism: 把AFD推广到再生核Banach空间，用原/对偶编码、潜变量到RKBS映射与动态卷积核解码对应分解过程。
contribution: 理论驱动的逆算子架构，并比较原对偶模块消融及多类逆PDE。
inputs_outputs: 解/源项或边界Dirichlet-to-Neumann观测→渗透率或势函数。
generalization_shift: 重点是逆问题与稀疏/不规则参数表达；未核实跨PDE零样本或跨几何协议。
training_seen: 监督参数—观测配对；正文比较训练1000 epochs；主网络128潜维、32通道。
baselines: NAO
NIPS
LNO
MWT
results: 表3磁Schrödinger任务中相对L2为1.50e-5；表4 Darcy中相对L2最好但MAE不是最好，NIPS的MAE更低。数值为论文报告，未复现实验。
limitations: 定理依赖Banach空间光滑/凸性及理想极点选择条件；实际CKN仅近似该选择。§4.2与§5的学习率/KL权重叙述不一致，复现需核对实现；本文未找到可验证代码链接。
code_status: 未找到已核实公开代码
fulltext_access: PMLR官方托管25页PDF已下载；正文、实验表与实现说明已阅读，证明仅轻读
innovation_points: 以双对偶配对替代Hilbert正交投影，使网络模块与AFD操作对应。
动态卷积核与残差传播实现自适应基重构。
contribution_points: 理论驱动的逆算子架构，并比较原对偶模块消融及多类逆PDE。
core_method_paragraphs: 观测经过原始分支和对偶分支的概率编码器，映射到学习到的RKBS及其对偶空间。谱卷积、点态卷积与残差传播更新潜变量，设计上对应逐步分解中的残差。
解码器通过动态卷积核执行近似的自适应基选择与对偶配对，累加重建未知PDE参数；训练使用参数重构项和潜分布KL项。数学对齐是方法动机，实际选择规则的近似与训练设置差异需要复现时进一步核对。

title: Multi-Level Monte Carlo training of neural operators
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
problem: 降低高分辨率神经算子训练成本，同时控制目标细网格损失的梯度估计误差。
mechanism: 用多层 Monte Carlo 望远镜分解目标梯度：大量粗层样本，加少量相邻细/粗层配对修正；配合分辨率感知的数据批处理。
contribution: 提供可跨 FNO、图算子、无网格 CNN 和几何 Transformer 的训练策略。
inputs_outputs: 输入不同分辨率的 PDE 数据及现有算子骨干；输出训练好的细分辨率算子。
generalization_shift: 主要是网格分辨率与训练成本变化，不是跨 PDE 零样本迁移。
training_seen: Navier–Stokes 3000 条轨迹，从 256 网格形成 8、16、32、64 分辨率；圆柱绕流 200 个算例，150 训练/50 测试，四网格独立求解。
baselines: 单一细网格训练
混合分辨率 batch
FNO
MP-PDE
无网格 CNN
GINOT
results: 作者在 Navier–Stokes 上报告相近精度下，相比 64 网格基线训练约快 11 倍、相比 32 网格约快 3 倍。对流扩散例中约 4 倍速度伴随测试误差从 0.08% 增至 2.1%，并非所有任务等精度。
limitations: 粗网格丢失高频/不连续信息时可能恶化精度，采样预算与层间方差需要调节；骨干必须支持多分辨率。

_abstract: Neural surrogate solvers of partial differential equations (PDEs) promise dramatic speedups over numerical methods, especially in scenarios requires many solves.  However, current accuracy-based evaluations do not fully consider two central issues: (i) neural solvers incur substantial up-front costs for data generation, training, and tuning; and (ii) classical solvers can also generate low-fidelity solutions at a sufficiently low simulation cost.  To explicitly account for these realities and fully incorporate end-to-end costs, we propose an evaluation framework centered on breakeven complexity, a metric that counts the forward solves before a learned solver is cost-effective relative to an error-equivalent traditional solver. To evaluate this measure, we apply scaling laws to determine how much training budget to allocate to data generation and discuss how to achieve smooth error-matching in diverse settings. We evaluate the breakeven complexity of many modern neural PDE solvers on three PDEs on 2D periodic domains from APEBench and a novel benchmark of flows past multiple obstacles generated by the GPU-native PyFR code. Among other findings, our results suggest that neural PDE solvers will be more effective on problems as problems get harder in terms of cost, dimension, rollout, physics regime (e.g. higher Re), etc.

_abstract: Neural surrogates for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) are usually trained on synthetic data from numerical simulators. As models grow and scaling laws demand larger datasets, the cost of data generation often outweighs the training cost and becomes the bottleneck in the scaling quest. Unlike data in other domains, however, each PDE sample has a tunable per-sample cost that depends on its numerical fidelity, with the resulting cost-accuracy trade-off governed by known convergence rates. We exploit this property by formalizing neural surrogate training as a function of both data quantity and fidelity under a fixed data generation compute budget, treating fidelity as a fine-grained discrete spectrum rather than a binary distinction. Building on this, we show that multi-fidelity training enables Pareto-optimal error scaling against data generation compute. By using simulations at lower fidelities as an additional training signal, our approach consistently outperforms training on the highest fidelity at matched data generation budgets. We validate this across six PDE problems spanning structured grids and unstructured meshes, two distinct error sources (discretization and iterative-solver error), and four surrogate architectures.

_abstract: Differentiable physics solvers underpin solver-in-the-loop ML training, gradient-based optimal control, and inverse problems, yet the practical cost of obtaining correct, usable gradients from a given solver on a given problem is largely undocumented. Integration effort, computational cost, gradient accuracy, and numerical conditioning vary widely across solvers and are discoverable only by trial and error. We introduce Mosaic, an extensible benchmarking framework for differentiable PDE solvers that standardizes access to solver gradients. Each solver is packaged as a containerized component (Tesseract) exposing a uniform gradient API regardless of language or automatic differentiation (AD) strategy, enabling researchers to evaluate, compare, and build on non-trivial physical solvers. Our evaluation of 14 solvers across fluid dynamics, structural mechanics, and heat transfer demonstrates that the benchmark surfaces practically relevant differences: order-of-magnitude variation in computational cost and Jacobian conditioning, alongside structural incompatibilities that eliminate solvers from realistic tasks entirely. Despite this variation, all solvers that produce gradients converge to similar optima, indicating that the practical barriers are memory limits, numerical stability, and setup compatibility rather than gradient accuracy alone. Mosaic is open-source and available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mosaic-bench.

_abstract: Compressible multiphase flows involving shocks and material interfaces arise in applications such as bubble collapse and droplet breakup, where strong nonlinear interactions produce complex interface deformation, mixing, and multiscale dynamics. Developing reliable machine learning surrogates for these flows remains challenging due to the simultaneous presence of compressibility, sharp discontinuities, and multiphase effects. In this work, we introduce the first large-scale benchmark specifically designed for shock-driven compressible multiphase flows, comprising 2.4 TB of high-fidelity 2D and 3D datasets featuring shock-induced bubble collapse and droplet breakup. We evaluate diverse surrogate model families on our benchmarking framework: Neptuna, including convolutional, spectral, transformer-based, and pre-trained PDE foundation models. Beyond standard MSE training, we investigate composite losses combining MSE with Sobolev, interface-aware, and structure-aware terms, together with adaptive loss balancing using SoftAdapt and GradNorm. Evaluation includes pointwise, spectral, feature-focused, structural, and physics-informed metrics. Results show that no single model performs best across all datasets and metrics, while composite losses significantly improve interface preservation and spectral fidelity. Among adaptive weighting strategies, SoftAdapt provides the most consistent improvements with almost no overhead compared to MSE-only training.

title: PDEInvBench: A Comprehensive Dataset and Design Space Exploration of Neural Networks for PDE Inverse Problems
problem: 缺少控制参数分布、噪声及训练预算的PDE逆问题统一评测。
mechanism: 以解场反推物理参数，联合比较监督/残差训练、测试时优化、结构与条件输入及模型/数据规模。
contribution: 提供五类PDE数据与ID、参数插值缺口、极端参数OOD划分，分离优化目标、表征及规模的作用。
inputs_outputs: 输入时空解场及可选时间/导数条件，输出标量物理参数或Darcy空间系数字段。
generalization_shift: 训练排除中间16%参数区间作为非极端OOD，另留两端10%为极端OOD；另测观测噪声。Darcy另用字段统计分布划分。
training_seen: 五类系统分别训练；多数结构比较约5M参数，另做0.5M/5M/50M规模试验。
baselines: FNO、ResNet、scOT、DeepONet；控制结构规模，并比较纯监督、物理残差与50步测试时优化。
results: 全文确认：监督总体优于仅残差；测试时优化对部分反应扩散/KdV OOD有益，对NS较弱；导数条件对干净输入有益，但可恶化噪声鲁棒性。不存在跨全部任务占优架构。
limitations: 极端OOD可严重失败；导数放大噪声。结论依赖各方程的数据生成、损失尺度与所选模型预算，不能外推到任意逆问题。
